qoi.scope: Postprocessing only; excluded from timings. Phase densities and sensible internal energies are reconstructed from saved p/T with the selected thermodynamic models. These may differ from the solver final pressure-linearized internal density. This is a reconstructed thermodynamic inventory, not an exact stored-state or boundary heat/work energy-balance validation. No cellwise relative-error claim.
